name: Ash Legion — jump-pack arm v1 · 1.2 scale review
notes:
Experimental Ash Legion variation: short mantle, integrated idle jump pack, exposed exhausts, thigh-length front vestment. Body and arm share 41x58 frame and shoulder [18,19]. Feet row 54. Separate glow. Not gameplay-tested or approved. Cloth and pack are static body artwork; no cloth physics added.
Jarred 1 Nov: needs native-pixel cleanup to match the equipment family. Palette noise, block grouping and near/far distinction remain outstanding. This candidate changes ONLY game_scale to 1.2 and review notes; original pixels, frames and sockets retained. All four body parts must use the same scale. Rendered at 1 and 1.2 with current main game rig; not battle/play tested or approved. Do not treat the render comparison as final art.

frames.note: Idle fit-test variation. No engine flame baked into artwork.
